notes_for_editor: The only tower-specific source is the firelookout.ca entry: coordinates and the 1963 map. Build year, design, height, staffing, fate and current access are N/A there and in every source I read. The name link to Head, Clara and Maria (Renfrew County) is an inference from the name only. The coordinates sit about 11 km from the township's listed centre point (46 10 N, 78 00 W, per Wikipedia), which is my own calculation. A Facebook group post (fetched as a teaser only) mentions a fire tower photo held by the Head, Clara and Maria Public Library archives, built on the Quebec side of the Ottawa River. I could not link it to this tower and did not use it; the library archive may be worth asking.
